title: Transient slab: rate, time integral and decay fit of the centre temperature (analytic)
description:
The transient_slab_decay slab (silicon, both x faces held at T_s from t = 0, implicit-Euler heat), post-processed with curve calculus.
Analytic centre value (image series): theta = (T_c - T_s) / (T_i - T_s) = 1 - 2 sum_k (-1)^k erfc(c_k K / sqrt(t)), c_k = 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, K = L / (4 sqrt(a)).
Derived curves tab: cooling_rate = gradient(theta) against d theta / dt = -2 K / (sqrt(pi) t^1.5) sum_k (-1)^k c_k exp(-c_k^2 K^2 / t) (reference dotted); theta_integral = cumtrapz(theta) from the first sample (t = dt) against its closed form, the integral of erfc(c K / sqrt(s)) ds = (t + 2 c^2 K^2) erfc(c K / sqrt(t)) - 2 c K sqrt(t / pi) exp(-c^2 K^2 / t).
Derived values tab: tau_fit / amplitude_fit = exp_fit of T_c - T_s over [1.5 tau_1, t_end] (first Fourier mode (4/pi) (T_i - T_s) exp(-t / tau_1); implicit Euler lengthens tau by ~dt / (2 tau_1) = 0.1 %), fastest_cooling_time = argmax of -cooling_rate (2 K^2 / 3, the image series' first term), theta_time_integral = the last theta_integral value.
The tolerances are estimates from the implicit-Euler lag (~0.4 % of the rise at t_end): tune them after the first run.

parameters.name: T_s
parameters.description: surface temperature in K held on both x faces from t = 0

parameters.name: dx_mesh
parameters.description: uniform cell size (odd cell count: the centre is a cell centre)

parameters.name: H_slab
parameters.description: slab height along y (insulated y faces: 1D)

parameters.name: k_si
parameters.description: silicon thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: cp_si
parameters.description: silicon specific heat in J/(kg K)

parameters.name: k_img
parameters.description: image-series scale K in sqrt(s): erfc(c K / sqrt(t)) (~0.28)

parameters.name: dt_step
parameters.description: implicit-Euler time step in s (the probe's first sample is at t = dt)

derived_curves.name: theta_integral
derived_curves.label: integral of theta from t = dt
